sections.title: From a branch to main: one gate the author cannot skip
sections.lede: What a contributor touches between a local edit and a merge. Watch the review gate: it is the only step another person has to act on.
rules: A branch reaches main only through a pull request (.github/workflows/ci.yml).
CI must be green before merge. Enforcer: required status check, rung 4.
🟡 "Write a test with every fix" is stated in the README and enforced by nobody, rung 2.
sections.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  A(["Contributor: an edit"]) --> B["cmd: git push branch"]
  B --> C{"check: CI green?"}
  C -- "no" --> A
  C -- "yes" --> D{"Reviewer: approve?"}
  D -- "changes" --> A
  D == "approve" ==> E(["🟢 merged to main"])

sections.title: The pipeline owns three refusals and one artifact
sections.lede: What CI runs and what it writes. Watch the publish step: it is the only job with credentials.
rules: Three jobs run on every push: lint, test, build (ci.yml:12-48).
Only the build job holds the registry token; lint and test hold none.
🟡 No job fails on a coverage drop; coverage is reported and discarded.
sections.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  P(["push"]) --> L{"check: lint"}
  P --> T{"check: test"}
  L -- "fail" --> X["🔴 refused"]
  T -- "fail" --> X
  L -- "pass" --> B["job: build"]
  T -- "pass" --> B
  B ==> R[("door: package registry")]

findings: "Write a test with every fix" (README) has no checker behind it.
